current_generic_engine.calculated_osmolality_input_convention: sodium in mEq/L; glucose and BUN in mg/dL

ministry_joint_note_376_2025.authority: Ministério da Saúde / SVSA / SAES / SECTICS
findings: Methanol assessment includes arterial blood gas, electrolytes, serum osmolality and calculation of osmolar and anion gaps.
Its clinical confirmation workflow includes metabolic acidosis with arterial pH <7.3, bicarbonate <20 mEq/L and osmolar gap >10 mOsm/L, and/or specific methanol laboratory confirmation.
The note identifies the Ministry methanol management flowchart as a complementary clinical instrument.

ministry_saes_methanol_flowchart.title: Fluxograma: Manejo da intoxicação por metanol pelo consumo de bebidas alcoólicas adulteradas

anvisa_surveillance_freshness.finding: Corroborates the relevance of metabolic acidosis and osmolar-gap findings but does not replace the Ministry/SAES clinical formula workflow.

verified_context_conflicts.finding: The Ministry methanol workflow includes potassium in its toxicology anion-gap formula, while the general application anion gap deliberately excludes potassium.
verified_context_conflicts.software_rule: Never replace the generic anion-gap formula. The potassium-inclusive calculation may exist only inside an explicitly selected Ministry methanol/toxicology context.

verified_context_conflicts.finding: The Ministry calculated-osmolality table uses a mmol/L convention and urea, while the generic application formula accepts glucose and BUN in mg/dL.
verified_context_conflicts.software_rule: Never substitute BUN for urea or reuse mg/dL values in the Ministry formula without explicit validated conversion. Keep the toxicology calculation isolated from the generic formula.

verified_context_conflicts.finding: Osmolar gap requires measured serum osmolality.
verified_context_conflicts.software_rule: A Ministry methanol osmolar-gap calculation must fail closed unless measured osmolality is explicitly supplied.

verified_context_conflicts.finding: Gap thresholds are embedded in a methanol clinical workflow and are not stand-alone diagnostic proof.
verified_context_conflicts.software_rule: Never infer or diagnose methanol poisoning from an anion gap or osmolar gap alone. Require explicit toxicology context and retain history/clinical/laboratory limitations.

bh5b_implementation_rules: Preserve the existing generic anion gap Na-(Cl+HCO3) without potassium.
Preserve the existing generic calculated osmolality 2Na+glucose/18+BUN/2.8.
Preserve albumin correction, corrected sodium, Winter and delta-ratio mathematics unchanged.
Add Ministry methanol calculations only as an explicitly selected toxicology context.
Never automatically select methanol/toxicology context from chemistry values.
Require an explicit potassium value for the Ministry potassium-inclusive anion gap.
Require measured osmolality for osmolar gap.
Keep urea and BUN semantically distinct.
Do not silently mix mmol/L and mg/dL input conventions.
Do not infer methanol poisoning from gap values alone.
Expose source-specific diagnostic/prognostic thresholds as contextual guidance, not universal metabolic thresholds.
Keep PT-BR and EN-GB complete and available offline.
